title: Protocol for Co-culture of Microglia with Axons
protocol: Scarify mice after intraperitoneal administration of anesthesia with butorphanol, midazolam, and medetomidine dissolved in sterilized water.
Chop the brain region of interest immediately following euthanasia.
Keep the brain or chunks on ice throughout the process.
Aliquot 9 mL of PBS into 50 mL tubes and cool on ice.
Cool all dissecting tools on ice.
Dissect the brain region of interest.
Chop up the dissected tissue with cold fine scissors or blades until no tissue lumps remain.
Collect the chopped tissue into prepared 9 mL ice-cold PBS.
Add 1 mL of 2.5% trypsin/PBS (final concentration 0.25%) and 50 μL of 50 mg/mL DNase to each tube.
Incubate for 15 min in a water bath at 37°C, agitating tubes every 5 min to mix tissue.
Add 10 mL of DMEM/10% FBS solution into each tube (equal volume of enzyme mix).
Mix by pipette approximately 20 times using a 10 mL disposable pipette.
Centrifuge at 180 × g for 5 min at 4°C with max acceleration and brake.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 10 mL of DMEM/10% FBS solution and resuspend cell suspension by gently pipetting.
Place a 70 μm filter mesh on top of a new 50 mL tube.
Filter samples by gravity flow through the 70 μm filter.
Centrifuge the flow-through at 180 × g for 5 min at 4°C with max acceleration and brake.
If the supernatant is cloudy, repeat resuspension and centrifugation.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 10 mL of DMEM/10% FBS solution and resuspend cell suspension by gently pipetting.
Count the number of cells and seed them at 5 × 10^5 cells/mL, placing up to 4 mL in a 6-cm dish (2 × 10^6 cells per plate).
Incubate the cells in 5% CO2 at 37°C.
Replace the medium on days 1, 2, 4, and 6 with 4 mL of fresh DMEM/10% FBS solution to remove debris and floating cells.
On days 9 and 12, add 0.5–1 mL of fresh DMEM/10% FBS solution.
For issues with microglial viability, please see Troubleshooting 3.
On day 14, collect microglia from supernatant and co-culture with the axons.
Proceed to step 34 for detailed steps of microglia collection.
Add 9 mL of PBS into 50 mL tubes and cool on ice.
Keep all dissecting tools cool on ice.
Dissect the cortex and chop up with cold fine scissors or blades until no tissue lumps remain.
Collect into the prepared 9 mL of ice-cold PBS.
Add 1 mL of 2.5% trypsin (final concentration 0.25%) and 100 μL of 50 mg/mL DNase into each tube.
Incubate in a water bath at 37°C for 15 min.
Agitate tubes every 5 min to mix tissue.
Add 10 mL of DMEM/10% FBS solution into each tube (equal volume of enzyme mix).
Centrifuge at 180 × g for 4 min at 4°C with max acceleration and brake.
Discard the supernatant, then add 10 mL of DMEM/10% FBS solution.
Mix by pipette (approximately 10 times) using a 10 mL disposable pipette tip.
Place a 70 μm filter mesh on top of a fresh 50 mL tube and filter the cell suspension by gravity flow.
Centrifuge the flow-through at 180 × g for 4 min at 4°C, with max acceleration and brake.
If the supernatant is cloudy, repeat resuspension and centrifugation.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 10 mL of neuron culture medium, and resuspend the cell pellet by gently pipetting.
Count the number of cells.
Seed 5 μL of cell suspension (5 × 106 cells per mL) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Incubate the cells in 5% CO2 at 37°C.
Collect microglia from supernatant on day 14 of microglia culture.
Collect all conditioned culture media from microglia culture dishes into fresh 50 mL tubes.
Add 0.5 mL of fresh microglia culture medium to the culture dishes.
Tap the dishes and gently apply the 0.5 mL medium to wash the cell layer and collect any remaining microglia.
Collect the supernatant including floating cells, and add to the same 50 mL tubes containing media collected previously.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C with max acceleration and brake.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 1–5 mL of neuron culture medium.
Carefully remove the silicon-based axon culture device from the dish.
Verify that axons kept along the microgroove line using an inverted microscope.
Seed microglia into an axon isolated culture dish at 1–2 × 10^4 cells/cm².
Incubate the cells in 5% CO₂ at 37°C for 6 hours.
Remove the culture medium with a pipette.
Fix the cells with 4% Paraformaldehyde/PBS at room temperature (RT) for 30 minutes without shaking.
Wash with PBS three times, each time for 5 minutes at RT while gently shaking.
Remove PBS and add Blocking solution containing 0.1% Triton X-100, 5% BSA in PBS.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour while gently shaking.
Remove the blocking solution and add primary antibodies such as anti-CD11b (alternatively, anti-Iba1) and anti-tau, diluted in blocking solution (1:1,000).
Incubate at 4°C overnight (12–24 hours) while gently shaking.
Wash with PBS three times, each time for 5 minutes at room temperature, while gently shaking.
Remove the PBS and add secondary antibodies diluted in 5% BSA in PBS (1:1,000).
Wash with PBS three times, each time for 5 minutes at room temperature, while gently shaking.
Mount with mounting medium and coverslip with appropriately sized glass covers.
